sections.whatsHappening: You and the other parties must serve and file documents at different stages. You must also serve and file a list of proposed witnesses (Form 13A) and of other persons with knowledge of the matters in dispute. A document served at least 30 days before the trial date shall be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.

If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial, it will be received in evidence unless the judge decides otherwise.
